suggestions.what: Give each crisis option its own small illustration or at least a distinct crop; stop reusing one scene three times
One verb set for orders on desk, map and dossier

fun.reason: The first two months had decisions I cared about; after that Accept all carried me and I was reading, not playing.

clarity.reason: Goal line, step hints and Recommended list told me what to do each month; the count mismatches and the rail overlap cost a point.

visual.reason: Title, dispatch, stamps and reveal are crafted; collapsed advisor cards, reused crisis art, misaligned card rows and a wrong flag are exactly what I look for.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Stamps, sound, art and a verdict feel authored; Accept all recommended x10 feels like a dashboard autopilot.

agency.reason: Never blocked; but with six points always full I was rarely asked to choose.

realism.reason: The reveal comparison to the real shoal is good; months 3 to 5 were unrelated crises and a seat projection for a one-party state.

replay.reason: Replay same opening is clear, but I saw no reason to try other choices since Accept all won.

recommend.reason: I would show it to a friend for the title screen and the reveal, with a warning about the middle.

verbatim: It looks like someone cared, until the advisor cards fall apart and I notice I won by pressing the same button ten times.
